name: Eco-Cinema Observatory (species-on-screen)
description: A doctrine-governed eco-cinema observatory and a reference implementation for evidence-preserving ecological communication: scroll-driven cinematic ecological places, a research/archive surface of attested ecological narratives, Darwin Core interaction archives grounded in the GBIF backbone taxonomy and OBO Relations Ontology, and a standards-only interaction-claim evidence-binding profile with a three-level reference validator that certifies traceability (not truth) of ecological interaction claims to their evidence.
